integrity: Complete analytic proof in RESULT.md. Existing numerical checker gives corroboration only; the proof is not inferred from experiments. No external formal or expert certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nonscalar real symmetric operator, standard real Gaussian k-by-n sketch with 1<=k<n, and starting vectors selected after drawing the sketch; the scalar case gives a singleton. Does not describe fixed-start risk, finite-precision behavior, or injective sketches. The earlier two-mode beta-tail sign probability is expressly excluded as a previously covered result.
title: Universal real-range obstruction for undersampled Gaussian Ritz quotients
